preview.readerIsPlanetHolder: You tend to notice Bird when they enter a situation, and your response to how they present themselves can make them feel seen enough to speak more directly about what they want. Because your confidence carries so much weight with them, they may start checking your reaction before making their own decision. Their body knows the difference between speaking for themselves and waiting for your response, and it shows in how they hold themselves.
